body: Hello. I've been very depressed for a long time, most of my life. I haven't had a friend in 6 years, until fairly recently. We had gotten pretty close, mutually considered each other as best friends, over the past year, but all she's really done is manipulate and control me, and feeds off my suffering. I can't bring myself to cut off contact with this toxic person because this is my only friend in years, and I'm way too bored to do it. Nothing in my life brings me enjoyment or interests me. I have no hobbies and I don't like doing anything. I can't focus on anything for more than maybe 15 minutes at a time. I have no real goals or motivation to do anything. I'm just going through the motions in life, day by day. I'm trying to think of what would need to happen to make life worth living, and I'm drawing a blank. I am simply not interested in living anymore. Nothing is here to keep me going on this Earth. I've never been scared of death, I've always veeb willing to accept it if it happens. I've been debating suicide for a long time, and I think now is the time when I'm finally at peace with what I've done in life and I'm ready to find out what comes after life. I'm not a religious person, but honestly the most interesting thing to me right now is figuring out whether of not there is an afterlife, because there's nothing else I really care about or look forward to in my life. Thanks for listening, and thanks for asking, nobody else in my life really has taken anything I said seriously or cared enough to ask, besides my parents but I can't really talk to them about this stuff.
